name: broad-git-add-deny-untracked-protected-file
description: Broad `git add .` must be denied when an untracked, NON-ignored protected path exists in the working tree. The previous precondition only inspected `git ls-files` (tracked) and `git diff --cached` (staged), so this exact case slipped through. The probe uses data/nested/deep/ : the whole data/ tree is a protected content class (hook rule), but .gitignore only covers data/*.db / data/*.txt / data/*.md at ONE level, so this nested path is NOT ignored — exactly the gap between the two layers. setupFiles materialises a synthetic zero-byte placeholder — it contains no user data.
